title: Pressed Neumorphic Card
summary: A card that switches between raised and pressed on click.
description: Swapping outset shadows for inset ones is the entire state change — the geometry never moves.
accessibility_notes: Pressed state also toggles aria-pressed and a colour accent, because a shadow inversion alone is invisible to many users.
ai_usage: Soft-UI selection tiles. Toggle a class that swaps the shadow direction; keep the transition short (150–200ms) or the press feels laggy.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Pressed Neumorphic Card</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "neumorphic-card-pressed",
    "title": "Pressed Neumorphic Card",
    "summary": "A card that switches between raised and pressed on click.",
    "description": "Swapping outset shadows for inset ones is the entire state change — the geometry never moves.",
    "theme": "glass-neumorphism",
    "categories": ["neumorphism"],
    "tags": ["neumorphism", "press", "state", "soft-ui", "toggle"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Pressed state also toggles aria-pressed and a colour accent, because a shadow inversion alone is invisible to many users.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--bg", "description": "Surface", "default": "#232a3a" },
      { "name": "--dist", "description": "Shadow distance", "default": "9px" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Light surface", "Accent colour when pressed", "Group of pressable tiles"],
    "ai_usage": "Soft-UI selection tiles. Toggle a class that swaps the shadow direction; keep the transition short (150–200ms) or the press feels laggy."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    body { background: #232a3a; }
    :root { --bg: #232a3a; --dist: 9px; }
    .npc { width: 190px; height: 130px; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--bg); color: #cbd5e1; font: inherit;
      font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow .18s, color .18s;
      box-shadow: var(--dist) var(--dist) 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5), calc(var(--dist) * -1) calc(var(--dist) * -1) 18px rgba(255,255,255,.05); }
    .npc[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #7c5cff;
      box-shadow: inset var(--dist) var(--dist) 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5), inset calc(var(--dist) * -1) calc(var(--dist) * -1) 18px rgba(255,255,255,.05); }
    .npc:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 4px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="npc" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Select</button>
  <script>
    (function () {
      var b = document.querySelector(".npc");
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true" ? "false" : "true");
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
